description: This file is a Node.js script for checking dependencies in a TypeScript-based project, including analyzing source files, dependencies, and version mismatches.

methods.name: checkDeps
methods.description: Main function to check dependencies across multiple project packages.

methods.name: innerCheckDeps
methods.description: Per-package dependency analysis, including TypeScript source analysis.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits AST nodes to analyze import declarations and dependencies.

methods.name: calculateDeps
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for a given file based on DEPS.list files.

methods.name: allowImport
methods.description: Determines if an import is allowed based on dependency rules.

methods.name: allowExternalImport
methods.description: Checks if an external import is permitted based on peer dependencies and built-ins.

methods.name: listAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively lists all files in a directory.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.
